q: Someone shows signs of a stroke (face drooping, arm weakness, speech difficulty). What is the right thing to do?
o: Wait to see if it passes
e: Correct: Keep the person comfortable. The other choices are unsafe.

q: It is very cold and the family uses a coal stove (angithi) in a room. What is the right thing to do?
e: Correct: Put it out before sleeping. The other choices are unsafe.

q: You work with machines in a workshop. What is the right thing to do?
o: Wear loose clothes near rotating parts
Tie back long hair and avoid loose clothes
e: Correct: Tie back long hair and avoid loose clothes. The other choices are unsafe.

q: A person has severe chest pain spreading to the left arm and is sweating. What is the right thing to do?
o: Ask them to walk to the hospital
Give them a cold drink and leave them alone
e: Correct: Call an ambulance immediately. The other choices are unsafe.

q: You are working in the school science laboratory. What is the right thing to do?
o: Wash your hands after the experiment
Smell chemicals directly from the bottle
e: Correct: Wash your hands after the experiment. The other choices are unsafe.

q: Someone sends you a UPI 'collect request' saying you will receive money. Which of these is UNSAFE or wrong?
o: Enter your UPI PIN to receive money
Remember you never need a PIN to receive money
e: 'Enter your UPI PIN to receive money' is unsafe; the other three are good practice.

q: A person is bleeding heavily from a cut on the arm. What is the right thing to do?
o: Wash it with hot water for long
Remove a cloth soaked with blood and keep changing it
Press firmly on the wound with a clean cloth
e: Correct: Press firmly on the wound with a clean cloth. The other choices are unsafe.

q: You are using a fire extinguisher. Which of these is UNSAFE or wrong?
o: Aim at the base of the fire
Stand very close in the smoke
e: 'Stand very close in the smoke' is unsafe; the other three are good practice.

q: You need to dilute concentrated sulphuric acid. Which of these is UNSAFE or wrong?
o: Add acid slowly to water while stirring
Use a fume hood if available
e: 'Pour quickly' is unsafe; the other three are good practice.

q: A person has severe chest pain spreading to the left arm and is sweating. Which of these is UNSAFE or wrong?
e: 'Ignore it as gas' is unsafe; the other three are good practice.

q: Concentrated acid spills on your hand in the lab. Which of these is UNSAFE or wrong?
o: Wash under running water for at least 15 minutes
e: 'Rub the skin hard' is unsafe; the other three are good practice.

q: Your computer shows a message demanding money to unlock your files (ransomware). Which of these is UNSAFE or wrong?
o: Report it to the cyber cell (1930)
Share it with friends to open
e: 'Share it with friends to open' is unsafe; the other three are good practice.

q: You get a video call where a relative's face and voice urgently ask for money. What is the right thing to do?
o: Keep it secret from your family
e: Correct: Be alert to deepfakes. The other choices are unsafe.

q: You need to dilute concentrated sulphuric acid. What is the right thing to do?
o: Add acid slowly to water while stirring
e: Correct: Add acid slowly to water while stirring. The other choices are unsafe.

q: You are preparing for a school exam and feel very stressed. What is the right thing to do?
e: Correct: Make a study plan. The other choices are unsafe.

q: An adult collapses, is unresponsive and not breathing normally. What is the right thing to do?
o: Wait for them to wake up

q: An adult collapses, is unresponsive and not breathing normally. Which of these is UNSAFE or wrong?
o: Call 112/108 and ask for an AED
Start chest compressions in the centre of the chest
Push hard and fast at 100–120 compressions per minute
e: 'Give them water' is unsafe; the other three are good practice.

q: Your phone shows a pop-up: 'Your phone has a virus, install this cleaner now'. What is the right thing to do?
o: Install the app from the link
e: Correct: Ask a parent. The other choices are unsafe.
